formats.key: Permit(address owner,address spender,uint256 value,uint256 nonce,uint256 deadline)
effects: Once anyone submits the signature (before `deadline`), the spender's WOO allowance over the signer's (`owner`) balance is set to exactly `value`. This replaces any earlier allowance rather than adding to it (AnyswapV5ERC20.permit: `allowance[target][spender] = value`).
It uses up the signer's current permit nonce (`nonces[target]++`). That same counter is shared with transferWithPermit.
If `value` is type(uint256).max, transferFrom never lowers the allowance, so it is truly unlimited. Any other value goes down with each use.
No tokens move and no native value is taken when the message is signed.
formats.shown: "Authorize spending of tokens" with four fields: the spender address (raw), the max amount in WOO ("Unlimited" at 2^255 or above), the expiry date and the owner address.
